caption: The video captures a small transparent plastic apparatus resting on a light wooden board printed with a grid, set against a near-black background. The device has a dark rectangular center filled with foam, flanked by a side housing with a blue element and another with a clear wheel. A vertical stream of soap bubbles rises continuously from the center of the apparatus, its height and density fluctuating as it swells into a tall column and later thins to faint puffs before re-forming. Individual bubbles detach from the upper part of the column and join a floating swarm of iridescent spheres that drift upward and sideways through the dark space. A separate cluster of foam rests on the board to the right of the device, changing only slightly in shape. The apparatus and board remain fixed, so the visible motion comes entirely from the rising and detaching bubbles.
